import torch
import json

model = torch.load('model.pth', weights_only=False)
sd = model if isinstance(model, dict) else model.state_dict()

# Convert to JSON-serializable format
d = {}
for k, v in sd.items():
    if hasattr(v, 'tolist'):
        d[k] = v.tolist()
    else:
        d[k] = v

# Save to weights.json
with open('weights.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(d, f)

print("weights.json created successfully")
print("Keys:", list(d.keys()))

python3 << 'EOF'
import torch
import json

model = torch.load('/app/model.pth', weights_only=False)
sd = model if isinstance(model, dict) else model.state_dict()

# Convert to JSON-serializable format
d = {}
for k, v in sd.items():
    if hasattr(v, 'tolist'):
        d[k] = v.tolist()
    else:
        d[k] = v

# Save to weights.json
with open('/app/weights.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(d, f)

print("weights.json updated successfully")
for k, v in sd.items():
    print(f"{k}: shape = {v.shape}")
